overview.tagline: The complete unit-of-measure library — SI and Imperial units with their conversions, for Fuuz app installations
description: A comprehensive Fuuz package containing all standard units of measure, unit types, and unit conversions for the Fuuz platform.

AllUnits@2.0.0.fuuz is a Fuuz platform package that provides a complete set of units of measure for use in any Fuuz application. It seeds three core data models — UnitType, Unit, and UnitConversion — giving your application a ready-to-use measurement system out of the box.

highlights.title: 164 units, SI and Imperial
highlights.body: The complete unit-of-measure library, with unit types for both systems.

highlights.title: 1,720 conversions
highlights.body: Pre-built conversion factors, including between SI and Imperial.

highlights.title: Replaces the default units
highlights.body: A fuller unit system than the platform's default seed data, for new Fuuz applications.

pricing.detail: Fuuz accelerators are no cost; you pay only for the Fuuz runtime.

support.sla: No service level agreement. Supported once implemented by a Fuuz services professional or an approved Fuuz partner.

prerequisites: Delete the platform's default unit seed data first, or the import conflicts with it.
Run deleteUnitConversion, then deleteUnit, then deleteUnitType, from deleteSeededUnitData.graphql in the repo. Check the IDs match your environment.

steps.text: Import AllUnits@2.0.0.fuuz into your Fuuz application and confirm the import preview.
